headline: Revenue and profit accelerate on broadening demand momentum
summary_short: Hilton reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3.34B, up 6.5% y/y and 13.8% q/q, with net income of $482M (+9.5% y/y) as system-wide comparable RevPAR rose 3.9% on higher occupancy and ADR.
summary_long: System-wide comparable RevPAR grew 3.9% (currency neutral) on higher occupancy and ADR, and net unit growth reached 6.1% y/y as the development pipeline hit a record 541,300 rooms (+6% y/y) after approving 42,900 new rooms in the quarter. Management and franchise fee revenue rose 6.4% y/y. Diluted EPS of $2.10 (adjusted $2.29) rose from $1.84 a year ago; the CFO flagged $17M of non-RevPAR items pulled forward from the second half. Hilton repurchased $932M of stock and paid $0.15/share dividends, bringing YTD capital return to $2.03B. Cash was $1,009M against $13.3B of debt. Full-year 2026 guidance issued alongside results: RevPAR +3.0-3.5%, diluted EPS $8.22-$8.35, Adjusted EBITDA $4.04B-$4.08B, net unit growth 6.0-7.0%.
